hooks.name: Fractured Shadows Continuity Check
hooks.description: Example album hook. Copy to .kiro/hooks/fractured-shadows-continuity.json and adjust the matcher to your song folders. Fires when an agent saves a Fractured Shadows song file and checks it against the blueprint's 12 continuity rules.

action.prompt: A Fractured Shadows song file was just saved. Read examples/albums/fractured-shadows/BLUEPRINT.md (Track Registry and the 12 CONTINUITY RULES; use your own copy of the blueprint if you made one) and check the saved song against every rule. In particular: no electronic/industrial elements after Track 8; Alaric's voice production identical in T11 and T15; the shard pulse only in T7-T10; 'I won't let the line die here' in both T11 choruses and T15; first natural sound (birdsong) only at the T12 outro; the first major key only in T16; the only key change in T17; Rikan's vocal texture evolves per track; the album-title phrase only in the T17 final chorus; no two adjacent tracks share more than 70% of their palette; (robotic layer:) only in T4-5. For Act 3 tracks (T18+), say which rules the blueprint carries forward and flag anything undecided. Report a PASS/FAIL table with a fix for each FAIL.
